experiment: CBF-5 Antipodal Schema Grounding + Exact Criterion Compiler

representation.encoder: Same frozen stock microsoft/deberta-v3-xsmall, revision eb2d654bf0a5b628c8be6c4be7d29118fbef95b8, explicitly FP32
representation.feature: Normalized mean of first-transformer-layer content tokens overlapping the parser's semantic-term character span, preserving intrinsic polarity; for single atoms and prototype questions use unchanged CBF-4 semantic_span policy
representation.lineage: Reuse corrected CBF-4 cached layer1 span features and token evidence for old atomic contexts. Encode each NEW isolated atomic context once, never a full composition or candidate; canonical context is the parser's visible atomic clause with terminal period. Exact outer operators/weights never enter neural input. Persist context text, spans, masks, raw layer1 states and derived features; no training, larger width, coefficient regressor, or oracle-axis selection.
representation.term_parser: Visible grammar and schema names only. Split explicit clause conjunctions and exact weighting/operator frames; retain intrinsic semantic comparatives inside alias atoms. Neither alias catalog, criterion IDs nor teacher weights may enter parsing or inference. Exact outer weights/operators multiply signed resolved atoms. Unsupported multi-clause syntax must fail, never silently drop an alias.
representation.scope: Controlled criterion grammar, not a universal English parser. All tested user examples included.

prototypes.membership: Exactly48 existing train atomic questions: four axes, both signs, magnitude1, six templates. No aliases, held wording, composition questions or evaluation outcomes used.
prototypes.formula: p[j,s] = normalize(mean(h(q) for the six training atomic questions in that axis/sign class)); same eight base prototypes in EVERY method
prototypes.query_tie_break: Canonical schema index for equal retrieval evidence; exact-zero orientation UNKNOWN. Projection-null FP64 roundoff norms<=eps*384 are also UNKNOWN, not arbitrary cosine directions.

projection.recipe: CBF-3 template-nuisance recipe reapplied in chosen layer1 span space: mean over balanced eight signed classes for each of six training templates, subtract grand template mean, FP64 SVD, machine-epsilon rank cutoff, retain all nonzero contrasts, rank<=5. Train only; no alias fitting or posthoc rank selection.
projection.application: P(h)=h-(h B^T)B; cosine re-normalizes projected h and the SAME projected base prototypes. Never refit/re-average prototypes after projection.

methods.cosine_positive: axis=argmax_j cos(h,p[j,+]); orientation=sign(cos(h,p[j,+])-cos(h,p[j,-])) within that chosen axis
methods.asg_projected: Same ASG after train-only nuisance projection of query and base prototypes
methods.cosine_signed: Strong ordinary retrieval control: nearest of all eight signed base prototypes, its axis/sign
methods.cosine_positive_projected: Positive-first control under the same projector to isolate antipodal effect from projection effect
methods.cosine_signed_projected: Nearest of all eight projected base prototypes; same-space strong control for projected ASG

compiler.literal: Code owns schema-name resolution, generic surface polarity, numeric/word weights, term aggregation, and exact fixed-unit scoring. Reuse CBF-4 lexical cues on recognized literal terms; do not apply generic least/most polarity to unknown aliases.
compiler.semantic: Only unknown alias atoms enter resolver. Sum exact outer multiplier times resolved signed basis atom into integer four-coordinate c(q). UNKNOWN causes whole criterion UNKNOWN; legitimate algebraic cancellation remains a zero vector.
compiler.state: Unchanged CBF-4 exact four-axis candidate strings/states, integer-percent summation before global division100; content tie-break, never candidate index.

cases.old_alias: All32 corrected CBF-4 alias questions unchanged, primary decision comparison on16 original unseen_wording states (512 paired rows)
cases.literal_tests: Every CBF-4 held literal polarity/composition/held-combination question, plus supplied literal examples. Require coefficient equality and1.0 decision/pairwise/exact-winner; not semantic credit.
cases.alias_composition: Fixed50 new questions: six unordered axis pairs, four intrinsic sign combinations, two surface frames. Frame0 joins complete variant0 alias questions with '; also ', equal weights. Frame1 wraps complete variant1 alias questions in 'With weight two: ...; with weight one: ...'. No literal axis names. Plus supplied natural least-likely-to-fail / regular-running-bill-small question and its most-likely-to-fail / large counterpart. Teacher vectors exact sum of signed atoms. Primary composition decisions on16 original unseen_criterion states; individual component labels diagnostic only.
cases.causal: Evaluate all old aliases and new alias compositions on both original test-state populations. Select one model-blind lexicographically first question per positive coefficient ray, then all ordered different-ray pairs on same state. Every question contains semantic aliases; filter only by teacher concrete winner changing. Report correct-new, changed-to-new, both-endpoint and tie-aware rates separately.
cases.freeze: Generator/questions/parser/prototype/projector rules committed before constructing or encoding new composition corpus. No wording/direction/threshold selection from outcomes. Reused CBF-4 aliases are a development screen, not an independent replication.

gates.G1_atoms: Old-alias joint signed-atom accuracy>=0.80; separately report axis accuracy, sign accuracy CONDITIONAL on correct axis with numerator/denominator, unconditional sign diagnostic, and joint accuracy. Zero conditional denominator is undefined, not perfect.
gates.G2_alias_decision: Old-alias teacher-top-set decision accuracy>=0.80, simultaneous paired semantic-direction-cluster bootstrap improvement lower bound>0 versus frozen CBF-4 best layer1_span, and absolute accuracy CI lower bound>0.3203125
gates.G3_literal_compiler: All literal tests coefficient-exact and decision/pairwise/concrete-winner1.0 for every method; zero semantic credit
gates.G4_alias_composition: New alias-composition teacher-top-set decision accuracy>=0.80; report component axis/sign/joint and exact compiled-vector correctness
gates.G5_causal: P(student_after==teacher_after | teacher_before!=teacher_after)>=0.80 on alias-containing criterion swaps. Do NOT additionally require student_changed; report that stronger metric separately.
gates.G6_permutation: Exact restored scores and content-winner under reversed and seed7-shuffled candidates for all semantic/literal cases; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN
gates.ASG_mechanism: An ASG variant must pass G1-G6 AND exceed BOTH positive-first and eight-signed ordinary retrieval in the SAME raw/projected space on joint alias atoms AND alias decisions, with simultaneous paired bootstrap delta lower bounds>0. If retrieval meets task gates without such an ASG advantage, keep simpler retrieval; never credit projection as antipodal benefit.

bootstrap.alias_unit: Eight signed semantic-direction clusters; all surface forms and paired candidate rows kept together
bootstrap.pairing: Identical draws and row populations for CBF-4 and all CBF-5 arms
bootstrap.familywise: Bonferroni over20 intervals: six method-vs-CBF4 differences, six method absolute decision accuracies, and eight planned ASG-vs-control joint-atom/decision differences; report nominal95% and simultaneous intervals

gates.diagnosis: Predeclare axis high>=0.80 and conditional sign high>=0.90. Low axis/high sign suggests schema grounding and justifies tiny axis-specific learned metric NEXT, not now. High axis/low sign suggests comparative orientation. Both high plus all task gates: expand schema axes before B-STEF. Both low: this frozen interface/prototype-retrieval recipe is operationally insufficient; a stronger criterion encoder is a next candidate, not proof semantic information is absent. Report exact counts and avoid high-confidence claims from tiny conditional denominators.
